result.topic_en: A note in German, apparently in another hand, with diagrams on dotted grids claiming that the eight-queens problem has only one symmetric solution (said to have been found by Gauss), and that inversions and 'perversion' give 8 variants of it.
result.transcription:
[diagrams: three dotted 8×8 point grids with connected points forming tilted square / polygon figures]

Es gibt nur eine
(von Gauß gefundene)
symmetrische Lösung
des Problems der 8 Königinnen:

[diagram: 8×8 square with diagonal cross-hatching; eight marked points joined by heavy lines]

welches durch halbe und ganze Inversion und durch Perversion[?]
8 Varianten gibt, die nur positionelle Differenzen bieten[?].
